chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bundar, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from Muhammad ibn Ali, from Ali ibn Uthman ibn Razin, from Muhammad ibn Furat, maternal uncle of Abu Ammar al-Sayrafi, from Jabir ibn Yazid, from Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), who said:
The Messenger of God (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'Beware of the wicked oath, for it leaves homes deserted of their inhabitants.'

key_terms.اليمين الفاجرة: The wicked/immoral oath — a false oath sworn deliberately to deceive, as opposed to an unintentional mistaken oath (yamin al-laghw) or an oath fulfilled (yamin al-bar)
key_terms.بلاقع: Desolate, emptied of inhabitants — a vivid plural form describing lands or homes stripped of their people; used to convey complete abandonment

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the consequences of swearing a false oath?
ai.summary: Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) transmits a saying of the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) warning against the false or immoral oath (al-yamin al-fajira). The Prophet uses a striking image: the false oath causes homes to be emptied of their people, conveying that perjury destroys families, communities, and social trust. In the context of early Islamic jurisprudence, oaths invoked in business dealings, testimony, and disputes carried immense moral weight; a false oath was not merely a lie but an act of sacrilege that brought divine punishment on the household of the one who swore falsely.

en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad Bin Bundar, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from Muhammad Bin Ali, froom Ali Bin Usman Bin Razeyn, from Muhammad Bin Furaat Khaal Abu Ammar Al Sayrafi, from Jabir Bin Yazeed, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Rasool-Allah<sup>saww</sup> said: ‘Beware of swearing the immoral (false) oath, for it invites the houses from its inhabitants to being deserted’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Bandar has narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from Muhammad ibn Ali from Ali ibn ‘Uthman ibn Razin from Muhammad ibn Furat maternal uncle of abu ‘Ammar al-Sayrafiy from Jabir ibn Yazid who has narrated the following: “Abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said that the Messenger of Allah, O Allah, grant compensation to Muhammad and his family worthy of their services to Your cause, has said, ‘
You must never take sinfully a false oath because it leaves the town barren.’”
